bot.welcome:
Hi! I'm the Reja bot.

To link your account, send me the code from Reja → Settings → Telegram.
bot.linked:
✅ Linked! Reminders and your daily digest will arrive here.

Commands:
/bugun — today
/ertaga — tomorrow
/hafta — this week
/yangi <text> — new task
/inbox — inbox

Forward any message to me and it becomes an inbox task.
bot.badCode: The code is wrong or expired. Get a new one in Settings.
bot.notLinked: Link your account first: Reja → Settings → Telegram.
bot.help:
Commands:
/bugun — today
/ertaga — tomorrow
/hafta — this week
/yangi <text> — new task (e.g. /yangi Report tomorrow 10am #Work !1)
/inbox — inbox

Forward a message to turn it into an inbox task.
bot.newUsage: For example: /yangi Call the client tomorrow 3pm #Agency
bot.snoozed: ⏱ I'll remind you in an hour
bot.reviewPlan: Pick your top 3 for next week 👇
bot.groupLinked: ✅ This group is now linked to “{name}”. Task changes will be posted here.
bot.groupBadCode: Code not found. Copy the command from the project settings.
bot.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
bot.test: 🔔 Test message: Reja notifications are working!
